Name: Transparency Settings
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b]Transparency Settings[/b] increases the transparency distance around players for trees and buildings, enables transparency for bushes, and adds custom settings for other object types. It also adds a few optional hotkeys.

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] Some objects cannot be transparent because they are drawn directly onto the in-game maps. If a building can't be built/moved by players (e.g. any buildings outside the farm), or if a tree/bush can't be shaken, this mod will [b]not[/b] make it transparent.
[line]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. [b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b]
2. [b]Download Transparency Settings[/b] from the Files tab, [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/TransparencySettings/releases]the Releases page on GitHub[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/971985-transparency-settings]ModDrop[/url].
3. [b]Unzip Transparency Settings[/b] into the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.
[line]
[b][size=4]Options[/size][/b]
This mod includes settings that control the transparency effects for each object type, along with a few hotkeys to toggle global transparency levels. GMCM is recommended for easier customization (see below).

To edit these options:

1. [b]Run the game[/b] using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file in the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\TransparencySettings[/i] folder.
2. [b]Exit the game[/b] and open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editing program.

See the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/TransparencySettings]GitHub readme[/url] for more information about each option.

This mod also supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. Players with that mod will be able to change config.json settings from Stardew's main menu or in-game options menu.
[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

Transparency Settings supports translation of its GMCM setting names and descriptions.

The mod will load a file from the [i]TransparencySettings/i18n[/i] folder that matches the current language code. If no matching translation exists, it will use [i]default.json[/i].

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files by linking them in a comment, submitting a GitHub pull request, or any other method.

The mod currently includes these translations:

[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/TransparencySettings/blob/master/TransparencySettings/i18n/default.json]English[/url]
[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/TransparencySettings/blob/master/TransparencySettings/i18n/fr.json]French[/url] (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/745980]Caranud[/url])
